check.description: The shell command run through sh, every few seconds until a run of it exits 0: a watch on a wait. Give this, seconds, or until.

every.description: Seconds from one run of the check ending to the next starting, 60 where not given. With check alone.

note.description: What the answer says once the wait is over or the check holds: what you are to remember then.

seconds.description: How many seconds to wait. Give this, until, or check.

until.description: The moment to wait until, a date and time with its offset from UTC as RFC 3339 writes it, such as 2026-10-24T09:00:00+09:00. Give this, seconds, or check.
